Iareva is a unitary absolute monarchy located in [[South Quia]], bordered by the [[Far Lands]] to the north, [[Desaki]] to the west, [[Mestjan Myaa]] to the east, and the [[Haanian Ocean]] to the south. Covering a vast area of 4,156,962 km² (1,605,011 sq mi), it is the [[List of countries and dependencies by area|5th largest country]] in the world by land area, yet remains [[List of countries and dependencies by population density|one of the most sparsely populated]], with just 1.9 people per km². The capital and largest city is [[Droskaneth]]. The official languages are [[Verstian language|Verstian]] and [[Iarevan language|Iarevan]], with [[Desakian language|Desakian]] recognised as a regional language in the western province of [[Euri]].

Iareva has been inhabited since at least 10,000 BFA, with indigenous [[Native languages of Iareva|native speaking]] peoples occupying the region's dense [[Wikipedia:Forests|forests]], [[Permafrost|frozen plains]], and vast river valleys long before the arrival of outside powers. The region came under the influence of the [[Ast-Desaki]], which incorporated much of the territory into its ast during the early 15th century AFA, bringing [[Desakian settlers]] and language into the western fringes of what is now Iareva. As [[Ast-Desaki|Ast-Desaki's]] power began to wane, a [[consolidation of Iarevan and Verstian-speaking lords]] unified the region into a single political entity in 1592 AFA, after the Ast lost the ability to project power in the region. Iareva emerged as a fully independent sovereign state upon the collapse of Ast-Desaki, inheriting vast stretches of sparsely governed frontier territory in the process.

Since independence, Iareva has worked to consolidate authority over its enormous interior. Despite its low population density, the country's [[Lists of countries by mineral production|abundant natural resources]] including extensive [[Wikipedia:Timber|timber reserves]], [[Lists of countries by mineral production|mineral deposits]], and major river systems underpinned steady economic development throughout the early to mid 1700s AFA. By 1765, Iareva had developed a notably high per capita gdp relative to its population, with a GDP (PPP) per capita of {{lahn}}28,889, ranking [[List of countries by GDP (PPP) per capita|12th globally]], and a nominal per capita of {{lahn}}20,635, [[List of countries by GDP (nominal) per capita|ranking 17th]]. Iareva's Krali Total Development Index stands at 0.876, [[List of countries by Krali Total Development Index|placing it 41st in the world]] and firmly in the high development tier, a remarkable achievement for a nation of its geographic scale and sparse settlement.
